status: Unexecuted expected data for the authored raw-ABI harness and the original Rust public oracle. No native, VM or Rust test has been executed for these inputs.

encoding.u64_words: Decimal strings avoid loss through JSON decoders with a binary64 number type. Each is serialized as exactly eight unsigned little-endian bytes.
encoding.source: Concatenate source_header_words_le encoded as four u64 little-endian words, then each chunk part (decoded hex repeated repeat times). A truncated-header case instead gives the exact complete source_hex. These are complete, unambiguous byte recipes without a line-count reference implementation.
encoding.large_recipes: Repeat recipes are compact complete input definitions, not materialized buffers or measured results. No large frame was allocated or executed during authoring.
encoding.stream: Start with initial_state, issue calls in listed order, and carry only successful first-three output words. Every expected state is literal author-supplied data; no candidate interpreter computed these expectations.
encoding.output: Initialize the full advertised output to the fixed a5 byte. On success compare all 32 prefix bytes and the unchanged complete suffix. On error compare the entire output, including any prefix, unchanged.
encoding.workspace: workspace_hex gives the complete workspace bytes; preserve them on every outcome.
encoding.status_layers: expected_core_status is the candidate Core result if its entry is reached. seed_direct_profile separately specifies the exact0de direct-wrapper admission and packed return. Oversize source recipes cannot demonstrate a Core rejection through that wrapper. Normal B3 wrapper/report binding remains a later gate.
encoding.defaults: Apply case_defaults to each call unless a call explicitly overrides a field. All declared Core error returns leave the complete output unchanged. No output sentinel field is a program input.

public_utf8_equivalence_scope: Only a complete concatenation marked public-valid-utf8 corresponds to Rust &str. Individual frames may split multibyte characters. Raw-only and arbitrary seeded-state cases are protocol checks and do not assert construction of a Rust &str of that conceptual size.
coverage_requirements: Bind the actual Core/normal B3 wrapper before checking expected_core_status. Separately check the seed_direct_profile expectations for exact0de direct-byte admission. Compare original Rust for public-valid-utf8 streams. A direct-wrapper rejection does not prove execution of the Core rejection branch.
For each partition_equivalence_group, compare the complete concatenated byte identity and final line count across the listed partitionings, including empty chunks.
For bounded public strings, an independent harness should enumerate every split point and byte-by-byte partition, without using the candidate algorithm as the reference.

Keep original under-budget and exact byte/token-boundary tests, warning text/token count tests, empty/leading-newline tests and mixed text/image/audio/encrypted-item tests unchanged when any future adapter is added.
Preserve original whole-crate/caller/native budgets. The recipes do not authorize raising fuel, timeouts, memory limits, skips or sample reduction.
Fuel exhaustion/cancellation is a separate non-success path; do not treat its output as a completed result or as a declared atomic transport error.
not_in_scope: Dangling pointers, forged lengths, overlapping borrowed regions or concurrent mutation are outside the caller contract; no unsafe memory reproducer is included.
No actual implementation, reference Rust, VM, native, source validator, generator or product test has been executed.
No coverage, build, lock, compiler pin or production-dispatch file is changed.

seed_direct_profile.name: hepta.hia.program.direct-linux-x86_64-borrowed-bytes.v1
seed_direct_profile.expected_core_reached_and_packed_return: For source_frame_bytes <=1048576 all corpus output/workspace capacities also fit: Core is entered and the packed u64 equals expected_core_status. For larger source frames Core is not entered and the packed return is 4294967296. This mapping is static source-derived expected data, not an observed native result.
